jobs.title: Volunteer Program Manager
jobs.description:
Are you a natural people leader who knows how to build community, inspire service, and help volunteers feel valued? Valley Humane Society is looking for an experienced and energetic **Volunteer Program Manager** to lead and strengthen a corps of more than 200 volunteers who support our animals, programs, and mission.



This is a people\-first leadership role for someone who enjoys coaching, public speaking, problem\-solving, and hands\-on program management. You will oversee the volunteer experience from recruitment and onboarding through training, recognition, retention, and, when necessary, difficult performance conversations. You will also partner closely with shelter and program teams to ensure volunteer support meets real operational needs.

 **About Valley Humane Society:**



Valley Humane Society is a private, nonprofit animal welfare organization incorporated in 1987 with an excellent reputation for quality care and community support. Envisioning a world in which every animal is loved and every person knows the love of an animal, the organization creates a brighter future for cats and dogs by encouraging and strengthening the bond between people and pets. Valley Humane Society is an equal opportunity employer; the team is guided by the values of Compassion, Companionship, Optimism, Gratitude, Collaboration, and Integrity.



Valley Humane Society is located in beautiful Pleasanton, CA, nestled among rolling hills and close to the Livermore Valley Wine Country. The area boasts year\-round recreation, top\-rated schools, and a vibrant sense of community. Visit valleyhumane.org to learn more.

 **Responsibilities Owned by This Role Include:**


* Leading, coaching, and mentoring a corps of more than 200 volunteers
* Managing recruitment, onboarding, training, recognition, retention, and volunteer communications
* Delivering engaging orientations and ongoing training for groups of all sizes
* Providing constructive feedback and handling conflict or performance concerns with empathy and professionalism
* Partnering with Operations and program leaders to align volunteer scheduling and training with organizational needs
* Representing the volunteer program at community events, speaking engagements, and outreach activities
* Tracking volunteer coverage, retention, satisfaction, attendance, and pipeline health
* Improving volunteer systems, processes, and engagement strategies through data and experimentation

  


**Basic Requirements:**


* 3\+ years of experience in people management, volunteer management, human resources, or a related coaching or leadership role
* Strong public speaking, facilitation, coaching, and interpersonal communication skills
* Ability to manage sensitive conversations and provide clear, constructive feedback
* Highly organized and comfortable balancing strategy, scheduling, training, events, and hands\-on volunteer support
* Comfort using data and reporting tools; volunteer\-management or CRM database experience is a plus
* Basic knowledge of animal care, handling, and shelter safety standards, or the willingness to learn quickly
* Availability for some weekend, evening, and holiday shifts

  


**Work Schedule:**



Full time with benefits

Culinary \& Quality Assurance Trainer (5231U), Berkeley Dining \- \#88881 About Berkeley
  
  

At the University of California, Berkeley , we are dedicated to fostering a community where everyone feels welcome and can thrive. Our culture of openness, freedom, and belonging makes it a special place for students, faculty, and staff, who are among the most talented and accomplished anywhere, including Nobel laureates, Pulitzer Prize winners, and MacArthur Fellows. Since our founding in 1868, we have been an engine for innovation \- driving intellectual, economic, and social progress that benefits California, the U.S., and beyond. Together, we change the world.
  
  

At Berkeley, the best careers are built on a foundation of continuous learning and growth . We actively support professional development by providing all full\-time staff employees with at least 80 hours of paid time per year and provide space for supportive colleague communities via numerous employee resource groups.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, AI-Native
jobs.description:
IREN is a vertically integrated AI Cloud provider, delivering large\-scale data centers and GPU clusters for AI training and inference. IREN’s platform is underpinned by its expansive portfolio of grid\-connected land and power in renewable\-rich regions across North America, Europe and APAC.
  

  

With 100% renewable energy, we build, own and operate our data centers and take pride in being at the forefront of sustainable solutions for the ever\-evolving applications of high\-performance compute. We believe that human progress is invaluable, but it should be done in the right way: responsibly, sustainably and having a positive impact on the communities we operate in.
  

  

We are hiring a Business Operations Manager to run the business of Cloud Operations and SRE, and to work 1:1 with the VP who leads it. One role, two halves that reinforce each other: you own how the org plans, reports and follows through, and you own the executive’s time, attention and follow\-through as a system you design and continuously improve.
  

  

We are looking for someone who already runs their own stack of agents and automations, who treats “a human did this manually” as a bug, and who measures themselves by what moved forward — not by what got scheduled.
  

  

If you have been the person on your team quietly building the workflows everyone else asks to borrow, read on.
  

  

What This Role Actually Is
  

* A business operations owner. You run the planning and reporting spine of the org: goals and OKRs, the roadmap, the cross\-functional programs, and the metrics that say whether Cloud Operations and SRE are healthy. You know the numbers before anyone asks for them, and you chase down the ones that do not make sense.
* A program driver. For initiatives that cross teams, you own the plan, the dependencies, the risks and the uncomfortable status update. Nobody should have to ask “what happened with that?”
* An operator. You will run the operating cadence: staff meetings, business reviews, planning cycles, offsites. You will run these end to end: agenda, pre\-reads, decisions captured, owners assigned, follow\-ups driven to closure.
* A force multiplier to the executive, not a filter. The executive support half of this job is a core part of it, not a legacy attachment. You will own the VP’s calendar, inbox, travel and follow\-through, and you will make decisions on their behalf inside clearly defined boundaries widening those boundaries as trust compounds. You understand what good looks like for implementing an agentic stack to be the filter, and the organizational change management necessary to drive the teams to that filter.
* An org operations partner. Headcount and requisition tracking, hiring loops, onboarding that does not depend on tribal knowledge, team communications, and offsites you own outright.
* An automation builder. Every recurring task you touch is a candidate for an agent. Weekly reports, status roll\-ups, meeting prep briefs, inbox triage and drafting, travel logistics, expense reconciliation, doc hygiene — you build it once, monitor it, and move on to the next thing. Your job is to work yourself out of your own to\-do list, repeatedly. There is plenty more to do after all of this is automated; it is why you are a force multiplier and an operator.
* A judgment layer. Automation is cheap; taste is not. You will know which emails only the executive can answer, which meeting genuinely needs 60 minutes, which “urgent” request can wait until Thursday, and which agent output is subtly wrong and must never go out the door.

  
* 5 or more years in business operations, program management, chief\-of\-staff or senior executive support roles, including direct experience supporting a senior executive, and at least some of it in a fast\-moving, high\-ambiguity environment (startup, scale\-up, or a team inside a larger company operating like one).
* Genuinely AI\-native. You use AI assistants and agentic tools every day, not occasionally. You can describe — in specifics — a workflow you automated, what broke, and how you fixed it. Prompting is not a party trick to you; it is how you work. Bonus points if you are well beyond prompting and operating with context and graph loop engineering.
* Hands\-on with agentic tooling. Personal AI agents and assistants for calendar, inbox and scheduling; general\-purpose assistants (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini) as daily drivers; and connective tissue between systems. You do not need to be an engineer. You do need to be unafraid of documentation and have a high level of taste.
* The ability to run a cadence and a program. Agendas, pre\-reads, decision logs, status that is honest when it is bad. You are comfortable holding senior people to commitments they made, in writing, in front of their peers.
* Comfort with numbers. You can build a reporting roll\-up, spot the metric that is lying, and explain a trend to leadership without dressing it up.
* Judgment under incomplete information, or with swinging\-door outcomes. You would rather make a reversible decision now than wait for permission.
* Instinctive discretion. You will sit close to board material, compensation, org changes and unannounced strategy. This is table stakes.

  

Nice to have:
  

* You have built something small and useful with low\-code tools — a script, a dashboard, a bot — because it was faster than asking.
* You have run a planning or OKR cycle for a technical org and lived with the result.
* You have been given scope beyond a traditional remit: a project, a budget, a vendor relationship, a team offsite you owned outright.
* Experience in an org where AI adoption was a stated strategy, not a pilot.
* Comfort with data infrastructure, energy, or high\-growth technical businesses.
* You have opinions about which tools are overrated.
* You know how to speak clanker.

* You want a stable, predictable week.
* You prefer to be told exactly what to do.

**About the Company**



Armada is the hyperscaler for the edge, delivering modular AI infrastructure from first deployment to AI factory with speed, scale and sovereignty. Named one of Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and to the CNBC Disruptor 50, Armada's solutions are deployed in over 60 countries globally for organizations ranging from energy to defense.



With nearly $500 million in funding to date, Armada is backed by leading investors including Founders Fund, Lux, BlackRock and Microsoft (M12\), alongside strategic partnerships with Microsoft, Dell, Palantir, NVIDIA, SpaceX, and Skydio. We are building the infrastructure layer for sovereign and edge AI \- rugged, deployable compute for customers that cannot rely on centralized cloud.



Working at Armada means taking ownership, driving autonomy, and delivering impact. You'll tackle challenges that haven't been solved before and help build something transformative from the ground up. What you do here will not only define your career but help further Armada's mission to bridge the digital divide for customers around the world.

 **About the Role**



Armada is building a world\-class experiential engine, and we're hiring a Senior Events Operations Manager to run the logistical, technical, and operational foundation behind our global events portfolio.



This role is the day\-to\-day operator of our events machine, ensuring every program is planned, resourced, documented, and executed with precision across the Americas, EMEA, and APAC. You'll support executive\-level experiences and collaborate closely with events leadership to uphold Armada's quality bar and ensure programs scale without sacrificing consistency or craft. This role reports directly to the VP of Experiential Marketing and will support across the entire events function.



This is a hands\-on, detail\-driven, high\-ownership role for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments and loves turning ambitious ideas into flawlessly run experiences.

  


**Location.** This role is office\-based at our San Francisco (HQ) office.

  


**What You'll Own (Key Responsibilities)**


**Event Planning \& Operational Delivery**


* Manage end\-to\-end operations for third\-party conferences, owned experiences, field programs, executive engagements, and internal events.
* Build detailed workback plans, run\-of\-show documents, staffing plans, production schedules, and contingency plans.
* Oversee registration, attendee communications, F\&B, AV, production, transportation, security, and on\-site execution.
* Support executive and VIP logistics, which may include travel coordination, briefing materials, green rooms, rehearsals, handlers, and on\-site movement, ensuring these experiences meet Armada's bar for polish and precision.
* Serve as a calm, decisive on\-site lead who anticipates issues, resolves them quickly, and protects the guest and executive experience.


**Systems, Tools \& Portfolio Management**


* Build and maintain the operational systems that keep the global portfolio running: intake, briefs, approval workflows, calendars, templates, checklists, and service standards.
* Maintain a single source of truth for event dates, owners, budgets, milestones, executive participation, content needs, and cross\-functional dependencies.
* Create scalable processes that ensure consistency across regions while allowing for local adaptation.
* Partner with Marketing Operations to improve event technology, registration systems, lead capture, data hygiene, integrations, and reporting workflows.
* Ensure systems and standards reflect Armada's experiential expectations and support the broader experiential strategy.


**Budget, Vendor \& Risk Management**


* Own budget tracking, purchase orders, invoices, accruals, reconciliations, and forecasting in partnership with Finance and program owners.
* Lead vendor sourcing and management across agencies, venues, production, audiovisual, fabrication, hospitality, transportation, gifting, and staffing.
* Support contract negotiations, scopes of work, change orders, payment schedules, insurance, permits, and compliance.
* Track inventory, assets, signage, collateral, and shipping logistics to reduce waste and improve reuse.
* Maintain risk, safety, and contingency standards for global events, escalating decisions at the right time.


**Cross\-Functional Partnership \& Measurement**


* Partner with Field Marketing, Corporate Marketing, Sales, Executive Operations, Communications, Product Marketing, People, Finance, Legal, and Procurement to deliver aligned programs.
* Collaborate across the entire Events team to ensure operational delivery supports experiential strategy, executive programs, and global consistency.
* Run clear planning cadences, document decisions, surface risks early, and ensure stakeholders understand ownership, deadlines, and next steps.
* Ensure attendee and engagement data is accurate, timely, and connected to the right systems to support pre\-event targeting and post\-event follow\-up.
* Create post\-event recaps that capture budget performance, attendance, engagement, operational learnings, and recommendations for continuous improvement.

  


**What You'll Bring**


* 8\+ years in event operations, experiential production, or event marketing in a fast\-paced B2B environment.
* Proven experience managing complex events end\-to\-end, including executive programs, conferences, field events, internal meetings, and multi\-vendor productions.
* Exceptional project management skills with mastery of timelines, budgets, logistics, documentation, and cross\-functional coordination.
* Experience managing agencies and vendors, including scopes of work, contracts, production schedules, invoices, and on\-site teams.
* Strong financial discipline and comfort owning detailed budget tracking, forecasting, reconciliation, and procurement workflows.
* Clear, proactive communication style and the judgment to know when to solve ind

jobs.title: Staff Program Manager, Operations
jobs.description:
Crusoe is on a mission *to accelerate the abundance of energy and intelligence*. As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.


We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy\-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.


We're looking for problem\-solving, opportunity\-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.


If you want to do the most meaningful work of your career, help our customers and partners advance their AI strategies, and be part of a high\-performing team that believes in each other, come build with us at Crusoe.

**About This Role**


Crusoe's Cloud Engineering organization is 380 people today and hiring toward 550\. The operating machinery that got us here — headcount tracked in spreadsheets, all\-hands assembled by hand, action items chased one direct message at a time — does not survive the next 170 people.


This role exists to own that machinery and replace it with systems.


You will own the people and operations layer of Cloud Engineering end to end: headcount and requisition coordination in partnership with our Recruiting team, all\-hands and org events with our EA team, intern and early\-career programs, manager enablement adoption, and the operating rhythms that keep a 380\-person organization legible to its leaders. Today most of the initial intake sits with the Chief of Staff. Tomorrow it sits with you, and it runs whether or not leadership is paying attention to it.


The ideal candidate is a program manager who thinks in operating systems rather than checklists, is fluent in spreadsheets and workflow automation, and is comfortable holding senior engineering leaders to a deadline without formal authority over them.

**What You'll Be Working On**

***Headcount and requisition operations***

* Own the headcount plan of record for Cloud Engineering in partnership with the Recruiting team: reconcile requisitions and position IDs across TeamOhana, Workday, and Finance's forecast into one source of truth that leaders trust and drive adoption of new processes the Talent Acquisition team puts in place.
* Run intake and prioritization for new and backfill requisitions: collect and sequence each leader's critical roles, keep pipeline status current, and flag where teams are net\-short before anyone has to ask.
* Partner with Recruiting and Finance on hiring pace, requisition sequencing, and where budget left on the table can open additional headcount. Build the requisition intake SOP that does not exist today.
* Produce and maintain the org chart and span\-of\-control view that HR, Finance, and Accounting currently have to request one\-off.
* Coordinate the interview machinery around engineering reqs: panel construction, interviewer capacity, and feedback completion. Own whether scorecards land on time.

***All\-hands and org events***

* Own Cloud Engineering All\-Hands coordination end to end: bids for topics, agenda, speaker strategy, deck production, and Q\&A follow\-up.
* Measure it attendance, participation, and satisfaction should trend over time.
* Drive adoption and engagement in engineering tech talks, site\-specific all\-hands, and org\-wide social programming across San Francisco, Dublin, Tel Aviv, and new sites as they come online.

***People programs***

* Own the intern and early\-career program for Cloud Engineering: request cycles, offers, mentor matching, performance tracking, and full\-time conversion. Stand up the pipeline at new sites and coordinate with the Cloud Engineering leadership team.
* Drive adoption of manager training and enablement in partnership with the People team.
* Build the functional onboarding program for engineers and engineering managers joining Cloud Engineering, and measure onboarding satisfaction against a baseline.
* Partner with HR on engagement and pulse survey cycles and Recruiting MBRs: readouts by org, action plans, and follow\-through.

***Operating rhythm and program hygiene***

* Own operating programs and planning calendar for the Chief of Staff organization: staff meetings, reviews, planning cycles, and offsites. What happens when, what pre\-work is due, and who owes what to whom.
* Produce the recurring leadership updates and executive readouts the Chief of Staff and SVP present from.

***Systems and automation***

* Treat every recurring chase as a defect. Replace it with a form, a script, a dashboard, or a scheduled reminder.
* Own the Sheets, Docs, Jira, and Confluence artifacts these programs run on, including structure, access, and hygiene, and migrate them onto real systems where real systems exist.
* Build a repeatable playbook any program manager or engineering manager can pick up and run without you.
* Own the communications and change\-management plan attached to each rollout. Adoption is the deliverable; the announcement is not.

**What You'll Bring to the Team**

* 8\+ years in program management, business operations, or people operations, including time supporting a large engineering or infrastructure organization through fast growth.
* Direct experience owning headcount or workforce planning operations: requisitions, position management, and reconciliation across Finance, Talent, and business leadership.
* A track record running an all\-hands or comparable large\-audience program for an organization of 500\+, with evidence you improved it rather than just de

jobs.description:
**Planned Companies – Operations Manager – Job Description**
============================================================

 **Schedule**: Monday\-Friday 8:30AM\-5:00PM

**Pay Rate:** $75,000\-$90,000 \+ Bonus

**Additional Income:** $400 biweekly travel expense

**Location:** San Francisco CA

**Summary**
===========


A Concierge Manager ensures exceptional service is provided to all residents and their guests. This role is responsible for engineering a professional Concierge team that maintains the building lobby and upholding our Customer Service Standard while carrying out all workplace expectations and policies including financial management to ensure payroll budgetary goals are met.

**Primary Job Responsibilities:**
=================================

* Ensures the Concierge Operations are operating effectively and in accordance with Property Management and/or Board of Directors' expectations.
* Maintain Client Satisfaction which will result in the retention of the Contract.
* Ensures each client and guest receives a Warm Welcome and Fond Farewell.
* Recruits, trains, motivates, supervises, and mentors team members \- leads by example.
* Ensure that all team members are trained to react intelligently and quickly to all emergency situations.
* Use Company Approved Team Scheduler to ensure payroll budget compliance.
* Complete necessary Payroll Tasks by Company deadlines.
* Produces a wide network of offerings to clients, including but not limited to car service, dog walking, dry cleaning, grocery delivery, etc.
* Smooth operation of contractor arrivals/departures and realtor/home buyer visits.
* Covers shifts for team members to ensure proper staffing requirements are maintained.
* Attends company meetings/trainings and ensures all team members participate in company training sessions.
* Weekend site visits, at least once per month, are an expected part of the role.
* Occasional swing\-shift and overnight visits are required for quality control, client engagement, and team support
* Bilingual candidates are preferred but not required.
* Candidates must be articulate, professional, and comfortable spending approximately four days per week in the field.
* This is a highly operational, field\-focused position and should not be viewed as an administrative or primarily work\-from\-home role.

 **Market Responsibility (must be willing to travel to the following):**

* San Francisco
* Oakland
* Emeryville
* San Jose
* Santa Clara
* Alameda

**Requirements:**
=================

* Experience in a field supervisory or management level position, previous janitorial or hotel\-like atmosphere.
* Professional background in customer service and hospitality management.
* Must be hospitality driven and offer any necessary assistance to clients and guests.
* Must be able to coach and mentor team members.
* Must possess the ability to multi\-task.
* Must possess ability to work in a team environment.
* Must be able to proactively learn about all events, happenings, restaurants, etc. in the local neighborhood.
* Basic knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word \& Excel) and the Internet.
* Proven organizational skills that exemplify attention to detail from beginning to follow\-up on each project undertaken.
* Proven leadership ability to develop and motivate team members and effectively provide supervision as well as train members to deliver high level customer service.
* Effective interpersonal communication skills (written and oral) with ability to engage positively with clients.
* Diplomatically handle delicate and challenging client concerns.
* Must be well versed in budgetary and cost control responsibilities.
* Ability to lift 50 pounds.
* Customer service: 5 years (Preferred)
* Security experience: 3 years (preferred)
* Reliable means of transportation to travel to portfolio sites

 **Benefits*** Full\-time employees (defined as working 30 or more hours per week) are eligible for medical, dental, vision and other ancillary benefits.
* All employees (full\-time and part\-time) are eligible to participate in the company’s 401K which has an employer match.

 **“*****Planned Companies is an equal opportunity employer. Planned Companies does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in the provision of employment opportunities and benefits.”***

jobs.title: Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**Position Overview**

Mariposa Gardening \& Design Cooperative, Inc. seeks an organized, collaborative, and solutions\-oriented **Operations Manager** to support the day\-to\-day operations and continued growth of our eco\-friendly landscape design build cooperative.

The Operations Manager reports directly to the CEO and is responsible for the systems, structure, and communication that allow our field teams, designers, clients, and field crews to work effectively together. This position combines **operations management, team coordination, scheduling, administrative oversight, client communication, and organizational development**.

The ideal candidate is a practical problem\-solver who enjoys working with people, implementing and upholding systems, and balancing the needs of a growing business with the values of a cooperative workplace.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations \& Administration**

* Oversee daily business operations and ensure that projects, crews, and administrative functions run smoothly.
* Administering and upholding the existing operational systems, policies, procedures, and workflows.
* Coordinate calendars, schedules, job assignments, meetings, and operational priorities.
* Monitor project timelines, staffing needs, materials, equipment, and other resources.
* Maintain accurate operational records and ensure information is accessible to the appropriate team members.
* Identify inefficiencies and implement practical improvements.
* Support purchasing, vendor relationships, inventory, equipment, and supply management.
* Coordinate office and field operations to ensure crews have the information and resources they need.

**Team \& Crew Coordination**

* Coordinate schedules and communication among gardening crews, install crews, designers, cooperative owners, and leadership.
* Help establish clear expectations, roles, responsibilities, and communication systems between all employees and departments.
* Hold all field crew teams accountable for weekly tailgate safety meetings and documentation.
* Uphold the Standards of Practice for each department and participate in the monthly Standards of Practice meetings for each department.
* Support onboarding and training of new employees.
* Facilitate regular team meetings and operational check\-ins.
* Help address scheduling conflicts, workflow challenges, and day\-to\-day operational issues.
* Promote a respectful, inclusive, communicative, and accountable workplace culture.
* Support cooperative decision\-making and help ensure that operational decisions align with the organization's shared values.

**Client \& Project Support**

* Serve as a key point of contact for clients regarding scheduling, project logistics, service questions, and operational concerns.
* Help ensure clients receive timely and professional communication.

jobs.title: Senior Staff Operations Manager, Office of the President (PED)
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Chief of Staff–style operator to serve as the President's right hand and help run, maintain, and continuously evolve the Product, Engineering \& Design operating model and cadence.



This role will turn strategy into a durable execution system. You will own the connective tissue across the President's leadership cadence: preparing the right inputs, creating clarity on decisions and tradeoffs, ensuring commitments are followed through, surfacing risks early, and improving the operating model as the organization changes. You will work across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Finance, People, and your peers in Business Operations, partnering with senior leaders who do not report to you and influencing through judgment, trust, and clarity.



The successful candidate will combine executive judgment, operational rigor, business acumen, comfort with ambiguity, strong written and verbal communication, and the ability to move fluidly between strategic questions and the execution details required to make the system work.



AI fluency is an important part of this role. You will use approved enterprise AI tools, including tools such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable platforms, to automate repeatable operating work, synthesize information across functions, improve leadership preparation, surface risks and dependencies, and accelerate strategic\-initiative delivery.



This role reports to the VP of Operations at Squarespace and is based remotely in California or locally at our New York City headquarters.


**You'll Get To…**
------------------


* **Run the President's operating cadence**. Own end\-to\-end orchestration of the leadership rhythm: staff meetings, WBRs, MBRs, and QBRs, finance and portfolio reviews, priority updates, and annual operating\-plan inputs. Ensure each ritual has a clear purpose, owner, input, output, decision authority, and downstream cascade.
* **Drive decision quality.** Synthesize diverse inputs into concise narratives that make priorities, risks, options, tradeoffs, and recommended decisions clear to the President and leadership team. Document decisions in the room, assign owners and deadlines, track commitments, and escalate unresolved issues with context and a proposed path forward.
* **Improve execution velocity.** Identify alignment and execution risks before they surface as leadership surprises, and facilitate resolution across Product, Engineering, Design, Commercial, Customer Operations, Finance, People, and Business Operations, connecting planning, performance, financial, organizational, and roadmap inputs. Use AI and advanced tooling to make decisions faster and better\-informed.
* **Evolve the operating model.** Treat the operating system as a living thing. Establish health measures such as decision latency, action closure, cascade reach, pre\-read quality, participation, recurring issue themes, and use them to assess whether rituals, artifacts, and escalation paths are producing the right outcomes. Recommend and implement changes to cadence, governance, templates, roles, and channels as strategy and priorities evolve, codifying what works so the model is easy for leaders to understand and operate.
* **Lead high\-priority strategic initiatives.** Drive complex, ambiguous, cross\-functional work on behalf of the President, from framing and workplan through decision, implementation, and follow\-through, including emerging problems that don't yet have a clear owner. Support annual strategy, goals, headcount, and budget processes by connecting them to the department's operating rhythm.
* **Represent the President and build transparency.** Stand in for the President in meetings, events, and discussions, exercising the remit of the position. Navigate difficult conversations and cross\-functional tradeoffs without relying on formal authority. Support two\-way access to the President through Town Halls, Roundtables, Office Hours, and written follow\-up, using sound judgment about what should be broadly communicated, selectively shared, or handled privately.
* **Serve as a trusted thought partner** to the President and senior leadership team, offering an independent perspective and respectfully challenging assumptions when needed.

**Who We're Looking For**
-------------------------


* Significant experience in Chief of Staff, Product Operations, Business Operations, Strategy \& Operations, or management consulting
* A track record of owning an operating model, leadership cadence, or portfolio of complex cross\-functional initiatives, preferably in tech companies
* Knowledge of the product / software development lifecycle
* Demonstrated proficiency with enterprise AI tools, such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Glean, Cursor, or comparable approved tools, and experience integrating them into daily workflows to automate repeatable tasks, optimize processes, improve synthesis, and accelerate project delivery.
* Exceptional written communication: you can turn a large volume of input into a concise, decision\-ready narrative tailored to the audience
* Strong business and financial acumen, with the ability to understand metrics, forecasts, resource tradeoffs, product or portfolio performance, and organizational implications.
* Strong executive presence and facilitation skills; you can create clarity and momentum in high\-stakes or ambiguous settings.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, build consensus, resolve conflict, and push for decisions without formal authority.
* High judgment and discretion when handling sensitive organizational, people, financial, and strategic information.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity, switching between strategic altitude and detailed execution, and taking ownership of problems that cross organizational boundaries.
* A continuous\-improvement mindset: you distinguish between process and content, challenge ineffective routines, and make change practical and durable.

jobs.title: Clinical Operations Manager
jobs.description:
*Clinic Operations Manager – San Jose –* (.375 FTE)

RotaCare Bay Area (RBA) is a volunteer alliance of medical professionals, organizations and community members dedicated to providing free primary, quality healthcare services to uninsured families and individuals with limited ability to pay for medical care. We are a volunteer driven organization supported primarily through locally based philanthropy. RBA’s network of 10 free medical clinics is in six counties throughout the San Francisco Bay Area and Central Coast. RotaCare Bay Area seeks new team members to join its RotaCare Clinics.

**Basic Function:** The Clinic Operations Manager provides administrative leadership and management control of all clinic operations. Clinic coordination, volunteer coordination, continuous quality improvement, and cultivating partnerships are essential aspects of this position. The Clinic Operations Manager will work closely with RBA and the Clinic Advisory Council to advance RBA’s mission as well as participate in program/strategic planning, evaluation, and fund development activities. The clinic operates on Saturdays.

**Reporting Relationships:** The Clinical Operations Manager reports directly to the RotaCare Bay Area CEO. The position also works closely with the volunteer Medical Director and Clinic Advisory Council.

**Knowledge/Responsibilities:**

*Clinic Coordination (35%)*

* Ensure clinical activities comply with RotaCare Bay Area policies and procedures.
* Manage clinic opening, closing, security measures, and housekeeping.
* Manage and communicate clinic schedule to ensure adequate volunteer staffing on clinic days. Resolve volunteer staffing cancellations in collaboration with the partner.
* Monitor and maintain exam room, medical supplies inventory and medical equipment.
* Ensure facilities are orderly, sanitary, and maintained.
* Train and ensure proper usage of electronic health records and documentation in Athena.
* Oversee laboratory and x\-ray procedures, including referrals, follow\-up, reporting, and MD review.
* Work with other social/health agencies and health care professionals to ensure patient needs are addressed. Includes coordinating specialty care and pro\-bono referrals.

*Volunteer Coordination (10%)*

* Ensure volunteer recruitment, training, and coordination with RotaCare Bay Area policies and procedures.
* Monitor volunteers’ performance. Recognize service, provide continuing education, or dismiss.
* Ensure volunteer database is current and accurate. Maintain and organize volunteer records, including assuring all licensing and tests are up to date in volunteer database.

*Continuous Quality Improvement Activities (20%)*

* Implement quality improvement activities in compliance with RotaCare Bay Area policies and procedures.
* Generate and communicate patient data reports.
* Identify and address challenges/barriers to conducting clinical activities.
* Analyze clinical activities to take effective action related to patient care
* Develop and institute solutions that improve clinic management services and healthcare delivery.
* Schedule, coordinate, and prepare for Quality Assurance Site Visits. Review Quality Assurance reports and follow\-up on recommendations. Develop and implement adjustment as necessary.

*Advisory Council Relation and Partnership Development (25%)*

* Work closely with partner on volunteer scheduling and clinic operations.
* Assist Advisory Council Chair with preparation of Advisory Council meeting agendas. Participate in Advisory Council meetings.
* Represent RotaCare at community meetings and events.
* Maintain and build network of social services and referral care providers to supplement patient care provided at clinics.

*General Administrative Activities (10%)*

* Manage office procedures and perform clerical activities.
* Serve as liaison to RotaCare Bay Area and participate in regional RotaCare Bay Area activities (e.g., conferences, teleconferences, meetings).
* Communicate with and respond to inquiries from RotaCare Bay Area and clinic network.
* Performs other duties as required.

**Qualifications and Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university with a minimum 5 years of experience working in a non\-profit health or human service setting with supervisory experience.
* Managing community\-based clinics is desirable.
* Knowledge of health care delivery, administration, quality assurance/CQI, data management, personnel management, and budgetary management.
* Understand medical terminology and ethical/legal issues in relation to healthcare.
* Strong, sensitive, and thorough verbal, written, and interpersonal skills, including leadership and facilitation. Demonstrated experience working with medical personnel and groups from diverse backgrounds. Bilingual Spanish/English preferred.
* Ability to function independently and as a team member. Values team\-oriented, cooperative culture. Ability to coordinate others to provide maximum efficiency.
* Computer literacy of popular Windows software (e.g., Microsoft Office Suite) and database systems (patient \& volunteer).
* Carries out all responsibilities in an honest, ethical and professional manner as well as demonstrates ability to exercise independent discretion and good judgment within parameters of the role and RotaCare Bay Area policies.
* Organized and self\-motivated. Ability to function well under stress and changing priorities.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and remotely.
* Able to occasionally travel. Good driving record with valid California driver’s license and proof of auto insurance.
* Ability to lift, carry, and move heavy items (e.g., tables, chairs, shelves)
* Uphold the Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA) regulations and policies.
* Interest and commitment to the mission of RotaCare Bay Area.

Pay: $35\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 per week

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Who we are**  

  

Pronto AI is a global leader in commercializing autonomous vehicle (AV) technology, deploying Autonomous Haulage Systems (AHS) that automate operations in mines, quarries, and construction sites worldwide. While much of the industry remains in R\&D, we deliver real, production\-ready autonomy that is already operating in the field.
  

  

We are on a mission to make mining operations safer, smarter, and more efficient through cutting\-edge technology, and we are building toward becoming the world's first profitable AV technology company.

  


**About the Role**



Pronto is looking for a highly organized and adaptable Project Coordinator to own scheduling and logistics across all customer sites. This person will be the central point of coordination for operators, field technicians, and site visits — building and maintaining schedules, arranging all employee travel, and keeping projects staffed correctly even as priorities shift and last\-minute changes come in. They will also handle expense reporting for project\-related travel, working closely with the Director of Program Management and the broader project team to ensure every site visit runs smoothly from planning through completion.



This is a critical, high\-visibility role: the Project Coordinator will be an integral part of the project team, directly responsible for making sure the right people are in the right place at the right time.

  

**What you'll do**

  

* Build, update, and manage master schedules and site visits for operators and field technicians, matching personnel based on skills, availability, and project requirements.
* Respond rapidly to last\-minute scheduling changes, cancellations, and urgent requests while proactively flagging conflicts and staffing risks to leadership.
* Book and manage end\-to\-end travel arrangements (flights, lodging, ground transport) aligned with company policies and budgets, adjusting quickly to itinerary changes.
* Prepare, submit, and track accurate expense reports and travel cost documentation, reconciling expenses against project budgets.
* Serve as the main liaison for field staff and project stakeholders to communicate updates clearly, maintain project records, and identify process improvements.

  


**What we're looking for**

  

* 2\+ years of experience in scheduling, dispatch, project, or travel coordination, ideally supporting field service or technical operations.
* Exceptional organization and prioritization skills to manage competing tasks and adapt under real\-time, fast\-paced pressure.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a focus on clear, timely stakeholder communication and proactive problem\-solving.
* Proficiency with scheduling tools, spreadsheets, travel booking platforms, and expense management systems.
* High attention to detail, accuracy in expense tracking, and reliable follow\-through.

  


**Why join us**


* Work on real, production\-deployed autonomy.
* Build technology that directly improves safety, efficiency, and productivity.
* Tackle complex challenges in demanding, real\-world environments.
* Be part of a fast\-moving team with high ownership and impact.
* See your work deployed and making a difference in the field.
* Collaborate closely with experienced engineers and industry operators.

jobs.title: FAA Assistant Program Manager
jobs.description:
About the Company
  
ADC LTD NM provides key services in Government Background Investigations, Armed/Unarmed Physical Security and Pre\-Employment Background Checks. Headquartered in Albuquerque, NM, ADC employees and contractors are located all over the US and its territories.
  
  

Summary
  
The Assistant Program Manager (APM) is responsible for regional oversight and management for the FAA Western Service Area sites. The APM oversees Site Manager (Captains) who are responsible for day\-to\-day operations of their relative site.
  
  

The APM serves as primary field\-level representative between ADC LTD NM Corporate Headquarters (HQ) and Site Management. This role is responsible for ensuring that all assigned sites and Site Managers (Captains) operate safely, efficiently, professionally and in accordance with company policies, union requirements, customer contractual obligations, and applicable laws and regulations.
  
  

This position Reports directly to the Executive Vice President/Program Manager (PM). The Assistant Program Manager will work closely with ADC LTD NM Corporate Executives, the FAA HR team, directly with Government Contracting Officer's Representatives (CORs), Contracting Officer's Technical Representative (COTRs), and Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) site Area Technical Representatives (ATRs).
  
The APM provides operational oversight and support to the Site Captains, Security Officers and site personnel. This position is responsible for maintaining site compliance, monitoring staffing and performance, conducting site inspections, addressing operational issues and ensuring consistent standards across all assigned locations.
  
The APM is expected to maintain a strong, professional field presence while keeping HQ informed of operational conditions, compliance concerns, staffing issues, incidents and client\-related matters. This role communicates regional performance and issues to HQ, and works both independently and collaboratively in a fast\-paced, dynamic company.
  
Essential Functions
  
* Provide Management and Oversight of all Site Managers (Captains) and Security Officers at each site under the Western Service Area (WSA) Contract.
* Provide daily guidance and advise Site Managers (Captains) on ADC Corporate requirements, policies, procedures, rights, and obligations under the contract terms.
* Ensure each site it compliant with contract terms, conditions and consistency with ADC LTD NM’s Corporate standards.
* Work with Site Managers (Captains) to ensure Security Officers are following post orders and contractual terms and conditions.
* Ensure Compliance with Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and FAR supplements and other Government contracting issues.
* Ensure Compliance with Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBA’s), and actively participate in Union negotiations, investigations, charges, disputes, and resolutions to ensure best value for the Government and ADC LTD NM.
* Issues contractual correspondence including evaluating and responding to Government requests.
* Attends meeting and briefings with Government customers and ADC LTD NM Executives including Government quarterly Program Management Review (PMR) preparation and presentation
* Provide input and support for Contractual Price Adjustments, Task Orders, Contractual Funding, Annual Obligations (De\-Obligations) including review and analysis of solicitations for Temporary and Emergency Support Services, terms and conditions determinations
* Ability to address complex Human Resource related matters and recommend solutions to specific staffing and retention challenges.
* Ensure Site Managers (Captains) are effectively managing staffing, scheduling, guard performance, training, client requirements, and daily site operations.
* Conduct regular meetings and performance reviews with Site Managers (Captains).
* Support Site Managers (Captains) in maintaining professional Government and FAA relationships.
* Provide coaching and guidance to Site Managers (Captains).
* Conduct scheduled and unscheduled visits to assigned sites.
* Escalate significate personnel or operational issue to HQ Executive Vice President/Program Manager.
* Perform all other duties and responsibilities related to the position as directed or assigned.


Education, Experience and Skills
  
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in lieu of a degree.
* A minimum of 7 years of managerial physical security experience or similar field; preferably with federal contracts.
* Ability to obtain FAA background vetting through VAP
* Strong understanding of security operations and compliance requirements.
* Strong leadership and accountability skills.
* Excellent communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple Site Managers (Captains) and locations simultaneously.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making abilities.
* Program/Project Management Skills
* Exercise sound judgment in a politically sensitive environment
* General management consulting skills and ability to interact with clients.
* Ability to handle personally identifiable, sensitive and confidential information.
* Ability to travel between managed sites.


Physical Demands
  
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands and fingers to handle, feel or operate objects, tools or controls, and reach with hands and arms. The employee is frequently required to walk, stand, sit for long periods of time, bend, balance, carry and pull up to 15 lbs., talk, see and hear.
  
  

Position Type/Expected Hours of Work
  
This is a full\-time position. Must be available to address emergencies and incidence(s) for non\-standard hours. Evening and weekend shifts may be required.
  
  

Supervisory Responsibility
  
Supervisor to the Site Captains on the FAA Western Contra

jobs.title: Compute Deployment Project Manager
jobs.description:
**About San Francisco Compute**
===============================


San Francisco Compute exists to give ambitious teams large scale supercomputers without taking on a catastrophic balance sheet risk. Most GPU clouds force you to sign long term contracts with no way out. If you underbuy, you miss the window. If you overbuy, you’ll blow up with no way out. It’s a desperate gamble that San Francisco Compute does not force you to play.


Originally, SFC was an AI lab that bought too big of a GPU cluster and was forced to sublease it or go under. Today, we build data centers, supercomputers, and then lease those machines on contracts that let our customers sublease. More than anyone else in the industry, we deeply felt the pain and fear of being forced to bet the farm with your neocloud vendor. To make it possible to sublease, we invented the first compute market and became the first one to offer physical settlement. That means we operate GPU clusters like a neocloud and derisk our customers like a market.


Customers buying GPU clusters don’t want to work through a network of brokers. They want to transact with the folks that have the keys to the cluster and can own the SLA.


To keep the industry safe from unnecessary risk, SFC needs to scale fast. To do that, we serve financially motivated parties as a technical partner to build, operate, \& lease supercomputers on their behalf. Basically, we help folks who want an economic return build GPU clusters on their balance sheet, but operated in full by us. That allows us to retain the technical control needed to operate a cloud, but scale fast like a market. SFC’s ability to offer subleasing can significantly increase the levered returns for cluster owners. Our hybrid model out\-performs brokered contracts or other “compute markets”, who have to go through a network of counterparties to solve problems. It also lets us design custom solutions for our customers, like clusters deployed in regions next to your dataset or physical eval set or a large CPU fleet deployed colocated with your GPU cluster.


Our team includes senior \& technical leadership from places like Lambda, Crusoe, Digital Ocean, AWS, and Hut8\. Our CTO is the cofounder and former CEO of Voltage Park. In prior roles, our team has deployed 8GW of datacenter capacity \& hundreds of thousands of GPUs. We’ve been described as having “the highest talent density in the space.” If you are an honorable, gritty person with eyes wide open \& good epistemics, who wants to see AI go right, we’d love to work with you. There has never been a more critical moment in history and it is up to us to shape it on behalf of those who come after us.

**About The Role**


We're hiring a Deployment Project Manager for the Compute Deals team. This is the person who owns what happens post\-deal signature: standing up clusters, driving them through bring\-up and validation, and carrying them to successful customer delivery. This is not a deal\-sourcing or procurement role, but you will run point on every workstream necessary to execute a compute partnership contract successfully, working with Engineering and GTM until the cluster is live and the customer is running on it.

**What You Will Do**

**Cross\-Functional \& Customer Coordination**

* Serve as the connective tissue between Compute Deal Lead, Engineering, and GTM, translating technical status into clear updates for internal stakeholders
* Coordinate compute provider\-facing and customer\-facing communication on deployment status and timelines, in partnership with Compute Deal Lead and GTM
* Influence technical and operational decisions across teams that don't report to you

**Partner \& Account Management**

* Own internal and external partner communication for every active deployment, keeping customers, providers, and internal stakeholders aligned on status, timelines, and next steps
* Coordinate directly with the Head of Compute Deals on contract handover, making sure deal terms, commitments, and customer context carry cleanly into the deployment phase
* Flag account\-level risks or opportunities back to the Head of Compute Deals early, so the deal team can get ahead of them

**Process \& Reporting**

* Run tight, recurring reporting on deployment stages, blockers, and upcoming milestones. This includes building dashboard, trackers, and standups
* Drive better handoffs from deal teams into deployment, tightening the contract\-to\-kickoff transition

**Deployment Ownership**

* Own end\-to\-end program execution for signed compute deals, from contract handoff through rack\-and\-stack, bring\-up, validation, and customer go\-live
* Lead multiple concurrent GPU cluster deployments at varying stages, sequencing dependencies across hardware delivery, site readiness, networking, and software bring\-up
* Define delivery milestones and acceptance criteria for each deployment, and hold the team to them

**BOM \& Technical Validation**

* Read and reconcile Bills of Materials against contracted specs, catching mismatches, substitutions, or non\-standard components
* Work directly with Engineering to understand rack configurations, node specs, and network topology well enough to ask the right technical questions, not just relay them

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 3\+ years in technical program or project management. Ideally in data center, infrastructure, hardware, telecom but not required
* A track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder programs over months, not days
* Excellent cross\-functional communication; equally credible with hardware engineers and commercial/deal leads
* High ownership and bias to action, comfortable escalating early rather than waiting for a problem to resolve itself

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Fluency in GPU/compute infrastructure terminology (NVL72, HGX, DGX, InfiniBand, rack/node topology)
* Demonstrated ability to read and work with a Bill of Materials; you understand rack configurations, node specs, and networking co

jobs.title: Field Project Manager – Travel Position
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

At **Utilities One**, we are driven by innovation, operational excellence, and a commitment to building the future of critical infrastructure. As a trusted turnkey solutions provider across **telecom, power, water, renewable energy, and data center** sectors, we deliver high\-quality services that connect and empower communities. In addition to our core operations, we offer **specialized consulting services** that help our clients design, optimize, and execute complex infrastructure projects with confidence and precision. We believe our greatest strength is our people — a team of dedicated professionals who bring expertise, collaboration, and integrity to everything they do. Join us and become part of a growing organization where your contributions make a meaningful impact.  

  

We are looking for a qualified **Field Project Manager** to support construction projects across the **Western U.S. market**. This travel\-based role requires flexibility and frequent travel to various project locations.  

The **Field Project Manager** is responsible for daily field execution, vendor oversight, and operational coordination of assigned construction projects, ensuring crews and subcontractors are prepared, compliant, and aligned with client and company standards.  

As the on\-site operational leader, this position coordinates field teams, vendors, management, clients, and other stakeholders to ensure projects are executed **safely, efficiently, and according to approved plans and requirements**.  

### **Key Responsibilities**

 **Project Review \& Pre\-Construction Readiness*** Review assigned projects for scope, constructability, and sequencing.
* Conduct pre\-construction walkouts with vendors and internal teams.
* Verify locate ticket status and ensure valid locates are in place prior to excavation.
* Issue required 48\-hour notices.
* Coordinate specialty services as needed (GPR, core drilling, line adjustments, FDOT scheduling, etc.).
* Confirm permits, traffic control requirements (MOT), and jurisdictional approvals are secured before work begins.
* Identify potential field conflicts early and coordinate resolution with engineering and management.

**Daily Field Coordination \& Vendor Oversight*** Meet with foremen/vendors daily to review work plans, expectations, and job sequencing.
* Monitor GPM check\-ins and ensure production is accurately entered and updated.
* Ensure vendors and crews:
	+ Have required documentation and certifications
	+ Are properly equipped for assigned work
	+ Follow approved construction methods and specifications
* Verify proper crew assignment based on work type (aerial, underground, boring).
* Enforce approved work\-hour restrictions per jurisdiction.
* Confirm crews are working in logical order aligned with locates and permits.
* Coordinate daily MOT needs and communicate requirements to management.

**Field Execution, Quality \& Compliance*** Conduct ongoing site inspections to verify quality and adherence to plans.
* Ensure compliance with:
	+ Required drilling practices (potholing, drain sock use, proper depths, DAP procedures, etc.)
	+ Underground depth requirements
	+ Aerial attachment standards and HOA requirements
	+ Safety regulations and PPE compliance
* Perform QA/QC checks on assigned projects.
* Ensure restoration requirements are completed properly.
* Confirm timely completion of assigned production units (“gigs”).

**Troubleshooting \& Issue Resolution*** Serve as the first\-line problem solver for field challenges.
* Assist crews in resolving technical issues and unexpected conditions.
* Coordinate map discrepancies and field changes with engineering.
* Investigate and report damages; assist with resolution and documentation.
* Maintain proactive communication when plans require adjustment.
* Escalate critical concerns to OPM or Director when necessary.

**Reporting \& Documentation*** Submit required daily and project reporting including:
	+ End\-of\-shift reports (EOS)
	+ Damage reports
	+ MOT updates
	+ QA/QC documentation
* Keep GPM updated with production, rejections, corrections, and completions.
* Ensure project documentation is accurate and submitted in a timely manner.

**Stakeholder Communication \& Representation*** Communicate daily with management, clients, cities, and jurisdictions as required.
* Attend coordination meetings when assigned.
* Relay updates, expectations, and changes to field crews promptly.
* Address homeowner or public concerns professionally and coordinate resolution.
* Represent the company as the on\-site operational leader.

**Resource \& Operational Support*** Monitor material availability and notify OPM when inventory is insufficient.
* Ensure traffic control requests are submitted and executed properly.
* Support yard organization and equipment readiness.
* Assist in developing field crews through training and reinforcement of standards.

**Authority \& Accountability**  

The Field Project Management / Field Project Manager is accountable for:* Daily field execution and productivity
* Vendor and crew compliance with construction standards
* Safety and permit adherence
* Accurate reporting and documentation
* Timely completion of assigned production goals

Other duties as assigned.### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

  

* A valid, unrestricted **Driver’s License;**
* Strong knowledge of **field construction, vendor management, and project coordination**;
* Ability to read and understand **construction plans, drawings, maps, and diagrams**;
* Strong communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills;
* Ability to work independently and effectively coordinate **crews, subcontractors, vendors, and other stakeholders**;
* Ability to work outdoors and in varying weather conditions;
* Willingness and ability to **travel frequently to different project sites throughout the Western U.S. market**.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Health Insurance plans (health, dental, vision);
*

jobs.title: CTMS Integrations Project Manager
jobs.description:
Job Title: **CTMS Integrations Project Manager**


Location: **Foster city, CA**


Job Type: **Fulltime**


**Job Descriptions:**


**Prime Skills (Must\-Have)**


* **Project Management:** 8\+ years of experience leading projects, including 4\+ years of building/maintaining project plans and managing RAID logs.
* **Data Integration:** 3\+ years of experience leading complex data integration programs (such as CTMS integrations).
* **Agile \& Data Sprints:** 2\+ years of experience managing Data Lake Sprints; strong knowledge of Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid methodologies.
* **Life Sciences Domain:** Proven experience working within Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotechnology, or Healthcare organizations.
* **Regulatory Compliance:** Solid knowledge of GxP regulations, validation processes, and regulated environments.
* **Tool Proficiency:** Mastery of project management tools like Jira, Azure DevOps, Smartsheet, or MS Project.
* **Stakeholder \& Risk Management:** Strong leadership skills to coordinate execution across cross\-functional engineering teams, manage risks, and provide weekly status reporting to executive leadership.

**Secondary Skills (Good\-to\-Have)**


* **Data Architecture Familiarity:** Experience with Cloud Data Platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), Data Warehousing, Data Lakes, and Master Data Management (MDM).
* **Data Governance:** Familiarity with Data Governance frameworks, tools, and data privacy standards relevant to Life Sciences.
* **Certifications:** PMP, PgMP, PMI\-ACP, Scrum Master, or equivalent project credentials.
* **Global Delivery:** Experience managing and collaborating with globally distributed teams and third\-party vendors.
  

  

**Job Description \& Role Overview**


**Role Summary**


We are seeking an experienced **Technical Project Manager** with **10\+ years of experience** to lead and support Clinical Trial Management System (CTMS) integrations for a global Life Sciences organization. This role is critical for an onshore customer account and requires an independent leader to drive the planning, execution, governance, and successful delivery of a comprehensive data strategy roadmap.


**Key Responsibilities (What You'll Do)**


* **End\-to\-End Delivery:** Lead Data Strategy, Data Transformation initiatives, and manage Data Lake Sprints.
* **Integration Support:** Drive the integration of Clinical Trial Management Systems (CTMS) with other core ecosystems.
* **Project Governance:** Develop project plans, manage resource allocations, and meticulously maintain RAID logs.
* **Cross\-Functional Coordination:** Align Data Engineering, Data Architecture, Analytics, and Business Intelligence teams.
* **Requirements \& Testing:** Lead requirements refinement (current/future state analysis), own User Acceptance Testing (UAT) planning, and partner with Validation teams to ensure compliance.
* **Compliance Assurance:** Ensure all project activities strictly adhere to Life Sciences regulatory frameworks and GxP standards.
* **Status Reporting:** Facilitate stakeholder workshops and deliver weekly project health reports to leadership.

**Soft Skills**


* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal, email, and instant messaging skills tailored for internal teams and client stakeholders.
* **Interpersonal:** Ability to give and receive constructive feedback during code/technical reviews and build productive relationships.
* **Problem\-Solving:** Analytical mindset equipped to troubleshoot and resolve bottlenecks efficiently.

**What Success Looks Like (612 Months)**


* Successfully executing key milestones of the Data Strategy roadmap on schedule and within budget.
* Establishing a structured governance model, including steering committees and executive reporting channels.
* Strengthening data governance processes and ensuring full alignment with organizational regulatory and GxP standards.

You will have the opportunity to collaborate with top\-tier scientists and engineers.

* Develop and manage end\-to\-end project plans to ensure timely delivery of milestones and deliverables

**Position Type:** Full Time  

  

Onanon, Inc. is a world class connector and cable assembly manufacturer that prides itself on supporting our customers with the ability to design \& produce custom interconnect systems for a variety of industries (Medical, Automotive, Industrial, Aviation, Military, and Commercial).
  

We are looking for a candidate that has a personality that matches Onanon’s affable culture and is passionate about manufacturing, out of the box thinker who has the desire to “make a difference” by engaging themselves in every layer of the organization. Creating and improving processes, controls and performance measurements in all activity that reduces cost, improve quality, and increases efficiency.


**Job Summary**
---------------


The Program/Project Manager is responsible for leading and coordinating projects and programs that support the design, manufacture, and delivery of cable and connector assemblies. This individual ensures that all initiatives are executed on time, within scope, and within budget, while maintaining alignment with customer expectations, quality standards, and strategic business goals.
  

The ideal candidate combines strong project management discipline with a deep understanding of manufacturing processes, customer interface, and cross\-functional coordination in a fast\-paced production environment.


### **Responsibilities**


**Program Leadership \& Execution**


* Lead end\-to\-end program management from customer concept through production release, including planning, scheduling, and execution of multiple concurrent projects.
* Serve as the primary customer interface, ensuring clear communication of requirements, timelines, and deliverables.
* Coordinate cross\-functional teams including Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, and Sales to meet project objectives.
* Translate customer and business requirements into actionable project plans, deliverables, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Manage project scope changes, priorities, and customer requests effectively.

### **Planning \& Financial Management**


* Develop and maintain detailed **project plans, timelines, milestones, and budgets**.
* Track program performance, cost, and schedule variances; take corrective actions as needed.
* Ensure cost control and profitability through effective **resource allocation and change management**.
* Support forecasting, capacity planning, and program\-level financial reporting.

### **Communication \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Facilitate effective communication across departments to ensure alignment and accountability.
* Prepare and deliver **project status reports, presentations, and KPIs** to leadership and customers.
* Maintain proactive and professional communication with customers to build trust and long\-term partnerships.

### **Quality, Risk, and Continuous Improvement**


* Ensure all programs comply with **quality, regulatory, and customer requirements** (ISO 9001, ISO 13485, or applicable standards).
* Identify and manage **risks and issues**, developing mitigation and contingency plans.
* Lead **lessons\-learned reviews** and drive **continuous improvement** in project management processes and cross\-functional coordination.
* Champion Lean and process\-improvement initiatives that enhance efficiency and delivery performance.

### **Leadership \& Team Collaboration**


* Provide guidance and mentorship to project team members; promote collaboration, accountability, and clear communication.
* Support a culture of safety, quality, and operational excellence.

Engage with engineering and manufacturing teams to resolve technical or production challenges impacting project success.


### **Required Skills / Experience**


**Education \& Experience Requirements**


* Demonstrated success leading cross\-functional teams in product launch or process improvement initiatives.
* Proven experience with manufacturing processes, NPI (New Product Introduction), and customer\-facing project management.
* PMP or equivalent certification preferred.

**Core Competencies**


* Strong understanding of manufacturing operations, including cable assembly, molding, connector assembly, and testing.
* Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Skilled in Microsoft Project or equivalent project management tools; proficiency in ERP systems preferred.
* Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills — able to influence at all organizational levels.

Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and changing priorities in a fast\-paced, high\-mix, low\-volume environment.


**Physical/Environmental Requirements:**


The physical requirements described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk, hear, sit, stand; walk; and use hands to finger, handle, or feel. Must be able to sit and/or stand for long periods of time. Ability to work in labs, at customer sites, and with hands\-on equipment. Occasional lifting of samples/equipment (up to 50 lbs). Regular domestic travel and occasional international travel.

  

### **Education**


Education:


* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Mechanical, or Industrial Engineering, Business, or a related field required.
* 5\+ years of project or program management experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, preferably within cable assembly, connector, or electronic component industries.

jobs.title: CLINICAL CARE ASSISTANT
jobs.description:
**Company Description**:


Axis Community Health, a nonprofit established in 1972, provides comprehensive healthcare services to over 15,000 individuals across all age groups in the Tri\-Valley area. The mission of Axis Community Health is to provide quality, affordable, accessible and compassionate health care services that promote the well\-being of all members of the community.




Our mission is rooted in delivering high\-quality patient care, encompassing primary healthcare, mental health support, and dental services. We are committed to ensuring access to essential healthcare services for every member of our community, irrespective of financial status, living situation, or insurance coverage.




**Job Summary:**


The Clinical Care Assistant is a medical assistant whose primary role is to assist the nursing team in communication with patients and other health care systems to better coordinate patient care. This role will also involve hands\-on care with appropriate level patient visits such as ear lavage, EKGs, and other assigned duties. The ideal candidate will have a high school diploma, one (1\) year of experience in a healthcare setting, and a current certification as a medical assistant.




**Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent is required.
* Minimum of one (1\) year of experience as a medical assistant in a healthcare setting is preferred.
* Current valid certification as a Medical Assistant is required.
* EPIC experience is a plus.
* Excellent telephone and patient service skills.
* Knowledge of patient billing procedures and insurance verification.
* Ability to work efficiently and effectively.
* Ability to work well under pressure, multi\-task and handles stress well.
* English/Spanish bilingual is required.
* Strong analytical, employee relations, and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent writing, business communication, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Ability to interact effectively and in a supportive manner with persons of all backgrounds.
* Proactive, self\-motivated and able to work independently in a fast\-paced environment as well as on a team with the ability to exercise sound independent judgment.
* Ability to maintain a high level of confidentiality and a professional demeanor and must positively represent the organization at all times.
* Ability to establish and maintain positive and professional working relationships.
* Ability to organize and set priorities and be able to adjust priorities quickly as circumstances dictate.
* Must be able to be at work regularly and on time.
* Must be a dynamic self\-starter with demonstrated ability to work independently or in a group setting.
* A can\-do attitude with attention to detail.
* Ability to type a minimum of 35 WPM with minimal errors.
* Must have good computer skills using Microsoft Office and the ability to use Axis departmental systems.
* Must be able to use office equipment (i.e. copier, fax, etc.).




**Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Monitor the Epic RN message pool and assist in triaging messages and routing to staff at the appropriate scope or level.
* Assist in responding to patient portal advice requests within scope.
* Follow Axis workflows in Epic and ensure all medical documentation is completed promptly and accurately.
* Assist RNs with translation when needed.
* Schedule patient appointments, follow\-up visits, and work with internal and external teams to ensure referrals and orders are completed.
* Conduct patient support visits that might include ear lavages, EKGs, blood pressure checks, and other types of procedures as ordered by providers or permitted under standing orders.
* Communicate with patients to provide education, instructions, and support regarding their care plan.

Trial Library is an AI\-native enrollment and care navigation platform that accelerates access to precision medicine. In collaboration with biopharmaceutical manufacturers, payers, and health systems, Trial Library enables the delivery of clinical trials as a standard care option \- improving patient access, advancing oncology outcomes, and reducing the total cost of care.
