**About Us**


We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, **Agital** supports three specialized agencies: **Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG,** with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

 **Go Fish Digital** is an engineering\-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion\-focused creative.

  

  

**WDG** designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission\-driven organizations.

  

  

**REQ** is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

  

  

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI\-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

 **About the Role**


Go Fish Digital is where digital marketing meets clarity, creativity, and scale. As our agency grows and our client engagements become increasingly complex and cross\-functional, strong project management is essential to ensuring great strategy turns into great execution.

  

The Project Manager serves as the operational backbone of assigned client work. This person creates the structure that allows Client Strategy and delivery teams to execute effectively, turning priorities and decisions into clear tasks, realistic timelines, coordinated resources, and measurable progress.

  

You will work across teams to keep complex client work moving, identify risks before they become problems, and create the visibility teams need to deliver on time and profitably.

 **What You'll Do**


You will own the execution system for a portfolio of complex client accounts and projects.

  

You will partner closely with Client Strategy and delivery teams to translate approved strategy into actionable work, coordinate timelines and dependencies, maintain clear project plans, and ensure teams have the information and capacity needed to deliver.

  

You will not own the client relationship or service strategy. Instead, you will create operational discipline around those functions, making sure decisions turn into action, risks surface early, and commitments remain realistic.

  

Your involvement will vary based on the complexity of the account or project. On some engagements, you may be deeply embedded in internal planning and execution; on others, you may provide lighter project governance and periodic oversight. Go Fish intentionally uses a tiered PM model based on account complexity, revenue impact, coordination burden, timeline risk, capacity needs, and margin exposure.

 **Key Functions**

**Project Planning and Execution**

* Translate approved strategy and project decisions into clear work plans, tasks, milestones, dependencies, owners, and timelines.
* Build and maintain realistic project schedules that reflect scope, priorities, team capacity, and delivery dependencies.
* Monitor execution, adjust plans as conditions change, and ensure decisions consistently move into action.
* Maintain strong project structure in ClickUp so teams understand what needs to happen, who owns it, and when it is due.
* Ensure assigned work meets Go Fish standards for task clarity, ownership, dates, estimates, prioritization, and actionable context.

**Cross\-Functional Coordination**

* Coordinate work across Client Strategy, delivery teams, and other contributors to keep multi\-service and project\-based engagements moving smoothly.
* Translate internal decisions into clear next steps and ensure owners understand dependencies, priorities, and expectations.
* Identify handoff gaps, conflicting priorities, and unclear ownership before they disrupt delivery.
* Maintain continuity as work moves across teams and help ensure important decisions, requests, and project context are not lost.

**Timeline, Capacity, and Risk Management**

* Maintain current, realistic project timelines and proactively identify work at risk of delay.
* Monitor team capacity and workload constraints, escalating trade\-offs before they affect client commitments.
* Surface operational risks related to scope, timelines, dependencies, staffing, or workflow and partner with Client Strategy and delivery leaders on resolution.
* Use sound judgment to address issues directly when possible and escalate repeated or material risks at the appropriate level.
* Regularly review assigned projects to identify overdue work, adjust dependencies, resolve capacity concerns, and protect delivery timelines.

**Margin and Financial Discipline**

* Help protect project and account margin through strong planning, accurate time estimates, workflow control, and visibility into actual effort.
* Monitor time tracking and hours against project expectations, surfacing material variances or scope concerns early.
* Support deferred revenue forecasting and revenue\-recognition schedules for applicable project\-based work.
* Partner with Client Strategy and Operations to identify when project demands exceed planned scope, capacity, or financial assumptions.
* Ensure project\-management practices support both high\-quality delivery and profitable execution. Project\-management KPIs at Go Fish specifically include margin protection, time\-tracking compliance, and deferred\-revenue forecast accuracy where applicable.

**Client Lifecycle and Project Setup**

* For project\-based engagements, develop the execution schedule and align the internal team before Client Strategy confirms commitments with the cli

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About PSE Healthy Energy**
============================


PSE Healthy Energy (PSE) is an independent science and policy research institute dedicated to generating science\-based energy and climate solutions that protect public health and the environment. Our multidisciplinary team of scientists, engineers, and public health professionals conducts research and actionable work across five key practice areas: Clean Energy Transition, Environmental Public Health, Climate, Energy Equity, and Oil and Gas. We design our research around real\-world challenges, proactively connecting our audiences with actionable, evidence\-based information they can trust.


**POSITION OVERVIEW**
=====================


We are seeking a highly organized, proactive, and mission\-driven individual to join our team as a Project Coordinator. This is a full\-time, non\-exempt role focused on providing administrative, analytical, and coordination support throughout the project lifecycle. This role is critical for ensuring projects are executed efficiently, on schedule, and within scope and budget.


As a Project Coordinator, you will collaborate closely with Senior Project Managers, scientific research leads, and project teams to support various aspects of project execution, including conducting detailed planning during project initiation, tracking progress and key performance indicators across the project lifecycle, and ensuring activities align with organizational and project objectives. You will support the oversight of timely completion of tasks and deliverables, budget monitoring and analysis, as well as foster effective communication among team members, collaborators, and stakeholders.


If you are successful in this role, you will support key projects across PSE and maintain healthy project operations in collaboration with the rest of the Project Management team. This role offers the opportunity to build and strengthen project coordination skills while making a meaningful contribution to cutting\-edge energy and climate research. We are looking for someone who takes initiative, communicates effectively, and thrives in a collaborative remote environment.

  

  

**ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**


* **Drive Project Success**: Partner with the Project Management and scientific teams to develop and maintain project plans, timelines, milestones, and budgets. Track progress, report on key metrics, anticipate risks, and help resolve issues to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery.

* **Manage Resources Effectively**: Support resource allocation, monitor project expenses against budgets, and maintain well\-organized project documentation and records.
* **Support Quality \& Compliance**: Help ensure projects meet reporting requirements and quality standards. Contribute to project reviews and retrospectives by capturing lessons learned and tracking follow\-up actions.
* **Improve Systems \& Processes**: Assist in refining project management tools, templates, and workflows. Proactively share insights and support updates that enhance efficiency and consistency.
* **Take Initiative**: Act as a self\-starter who identifies opportunities to add value, manages competing priorities with minimal supervision, and contributes enthusiastically to a collaborative, mission\-driven environment.


**REQUIRED SKILLS**


* 2\+ years of experience in project coordination, project analysis, or related administrative support roles (preferably in a fast\-paced setting).
* Strong passion for and/or knowledge of climate, energy, environment, public health, and/or energy policy issues (or a demonstrated eagerness to learn quickly).
* Excellent organizational, time\-management, and prioritization skills with a proven ability to meet deadlines.
* Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, paired with strong interpersonal abilities to collaborate effectively with diverse teams and stakeholders.
* Proficiency with project management tools (Asana, Google Workspace, Slack) and experience tracking budgets/expenses.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and attention\-to\-detail skills.
* Self\-starter mindset comfortable working independently in a remote environment.
* Commitment to PSE Healthy Energy's mission and values, plus a sense of humor and enthusiasm for impactful work.


**DESIRED SKILLS**


* Bachelor's degree in Project Management, Business Administration, Environmental Studies, Policy, or a related field.
* Familiarity with project management methodologies (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid).
* Prior experience in research, academic, scientific, or nonprofit environments.
* Comfort using AI tools (e.g., Claude) to boost productivity and coordination.


**LOCATION and WORK CONDITIONS**


Remote within the United States. This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship (e.g., H\-1B, O\-1, etc).
  

  

Position requires computer usage and sitting for extended periods of time, good hand\-eye coordination, arm, hand, and finger dexterity, including ability to grasp, and visual acuity to use a keyboard, operate equipment and read technical information. Overall mobility is essential.

jobs.title: Team Lead, Patient Support Center
jobs.description:
Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our Mission is to “Transform mental health by making it more accessible, affordable and effective”.

**Who We Are**


Geode Health is a rapidly growing, national provider of outpatient mental health services. Our mission is to empower our patients to live healthier, more rewarding lives through accessible, affordable, and effective mental healthcare tailored to their needs. Our Patient Support Center is the front door to that care, often a patient’s first human connection with Geode and the first step in removing barriers between someone seeking help and the provider who can support them.

**The Role**


The **Team Lead, Patient Support Center** is a supervisor\-level role responsible for supporting day\-to\-day operations, team performance, and service quality across the Patient Support Center. This role helps lead Patient Support Specialists as they convert high\-intent inbound calls, referral callbacks, and web leads into scheduled first visits, while also supporting a smaller volume of established patient call handling and routing hand\-offs.


The Team Lead serves as a hands\-on coach, escalation resource, and operational partner to the Manager, Patient Support. This person helps ensure the team meets expectations for answer rate, service level, conversion, quality, documentation, after\-call work, and patient experience while supporting a positive, accountable, and growth\-oriented team culture.

**What You’ll Do**

***Lead Daily Patient Support Center Operations***

* Operate as a player\-coach, with approximately 80% of time focused on supervisory responsibilities and up to 20% reserved for peak\-volume support, reserve coverage, or frontline call handling as needed.
* Monitor call queues, workflows, staffing coverage, after\-call work, and other operational metrics to support timely, effective patient access.
* Help coordinate daily team priorities, workflow adjustments, and coverage needs in partnership with the Manager, Patient Support.
* Serve as an escalation point for complex or unresolved patient concerns, ensuring prompt, professional, and patient\-centered resolution. Support on\-call escalation coverage during weekday and weekend extended hours.
* Support adherence to policies, procedures, HIPAA requirements, documentation standards, and quality expectations.

***Coach and Develop Patient Support Specialists***

* Provide timely and actionable coaching, feedback, and support to help Patient Support Specialists strengthen call quality, conversion, accuracy, and patient experience.
* Support onboarding, training, and ongoing skill development for new and existing team members.
* Partner with the Manager, Patient Support to identify performance trends, coaching needs, and opportunities for team improvement.
* Contribute to a positive, inclusive team culture grounded in accountability, collaboration, learning, and Geode’s mission.

***Drive Quality, Conversion, and Patient Experience***

* Help the team convert high\-intent inbound calls, referral callbacks, and web leads into scheduled first visits through empathy, clarity, and effective barrier removal.
* Audit patient interactions and system documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with operational standards.
* Use reporting, call review, and performance insights to recommend workflow improvements and strengthen team outcomes.
* Model calm, personalized, hospitality\-driven service that helps patients feel confident taking the next step in care.

**Who You Are**

* A people\-centered leader who enjoys coaching others and helping teams perform at their best.
* Calm, organized, and confident in a fast\-paced, phone\-based and multichannel (text, email, portal, web chat) environment with changing priorities.
* A strong communicator who can support sensitive patient situations with empathy, professionalism, and sound judgment.
* Motivated by measurable goals and comfortable using feedback, reporting, and performance insights to improve outcomes.
* Collaborative, accountable, and willing to jump in where needed to support the team and the patient experience.
* Passionate about mental healthcare and Geode’s mission to expand access to exceptional care.

**What You Bring**

* 3–5\+ years of experience in a healthcare, call center, patient access, customer service, or hospitality environment; prior team lead or supervisory experience preferred.
* Experience coaching, training, or supporting frontline team members in a goal\-oriented, quality\-focused environment.
* Strong understanding of call center workflows, service levels, documentation expectations, and patient experience standards.
* Familiarity with insurance plans, scheduling workflows, EMR systems, and patient access processes preferred.
* Strong computer skills and the ability to navigate multiple systems while supporting team members and patients.
* A quiet, professional remote workspace and reliable connectivity.
* Associate’s or bachelor’s degree preferred.

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Form Health** is a national telemedicine weight loss clinic specialized in helping patients with obesity lose weight and lead healthier lives. Obesity impacts more than 40% of the US adult population, but only about 1% of patients receive medical treatment for their disease. The field of Obesity Medicine is entering a period of rapid growth that will see treatment rates surge. Today, Form Health can harness this growth to drive patient impact nationwide. We do this by making research\-based treatment available to patients through the convenience of telehealth, including long\-term care from a specialized physician and dietitian and FDA\-approved medication when appropriate. We hold ourselves to the highest standards of clinical care, and to treating every individual with empathy and respect.



Founded in 2019, Form Health is a venture\-backed startup with an experienced clinical team. Form Health's mission is to empower patients and be the leader in obesity medicine using personalized, research\-based treatment delivered through modern technology. The Patient Care Coordinator role supports physicians, dietitians and patients and is critical to our company mission of outstanding clinical care.


**About the role:**



Form Health's Patient Care Coordinators (PCCs) provide comprehensive support for daily clinical operations, ensuring our patients have a smooth, caring, and well\-organized experience from their very first interaction. Working collaboratively with medical clinicians and registered dietitians, PCCs support processes that enable excellent patient care. This includes a wide range of tasks from managing the patient's care team experience, coordinating patient scheduling, and assisting with benefits coordination, to answering questions regarding prescription fulfillment, and coordinating with external providers. PCCs will also provide essential support to clinicians by managing pre\-visit lab work and inputting vital sign and medical record documentation. We are passionate about helping people improve their health through weight loss and will provide you opportunities for learning and professional growth. This role is 100% remote.


**Where You'll Deliver Impact:**



We seek an experienced Medical Assistant, a collaborative team player with exceptional interpersonal and organizational skills, who is passionate about being part of a healthcare team and excited to work in a non\-traditional telemedicine practice environment. Ultimately, your role is about being organized, thoughtful, and empathetic, making sure every patient feels personally supported at every step of their journey.


**Key responsibilities include:**


**Care Team Management:**


* Acting as the primary point of contact to maintain communication flow between patients and their care team.

* Providing routine administrative support for clinicians
* Contributing to special projects as directed, helping to improve our systems and make care more efficient and effective.


**Lab / Medical Records Support:**


* Helping collect medical records from primary care or other providers when needed.

**Membership / Program Status:**


* Guiding new patients through what to expect, both at the start and throughout their weight loss journey.

* Providing feedback and communicating patient feedback to other company teams (i.e. Product, Engineering, Marketing) to improve operational tools and patient care.
* Assisting with clinical data collection as needed to track company's key clinical performance indicators or for quality improvement purposes.

* Answering eligibility questions.


**You'll Be Successful in This Role Because You Have:**

**WHY THIS ROLE EXISTS**


EarthKind is growing fast in the farm, ranch, and hardware channel, and this is the role that owns that growth. The channel runs from national and regional farm and ranch retailers to hardware co\-ops and home improvement chains. Menards and Tractor Supply are the two largest accounts in it today, and they anchor a portfolio we expect you to broaden across the channel. You will be the headquarters contact those customers call, and the person who decides where the trade dollars go, what the line review deck argues, and how our broker partners spend their hours in store.


This is a small, fast\-moving company, which cuts both ways. There is no layer between you and the buyer, and no layer between your decisions and the P\&L — a call you make in March shows up in the numbers by June. If you want a seat where you can see your own fingerprints on the business, this is one. If you want a large support apparatus behind you, it is not.

**ABOUT EARTHKIND**


EarthKind makes plant\-based pest prevention products that work without the poisons and traps most households would rather not have in the house. Our Fresh Cab Botanical Rodent Repellent is the first and only EPA registered rodent repellent for indoor use, with over 60 million pouches sold in the last 15 years. We manufacture and distribute from our headquarters in Mooresville, NC.

* A forecast that Operations and Supply Chain trust enough to build to.
* Broker partners running against a written scorecard, with clear priorities and a regular review cadence.

* 4\+ years in CPG sales, key account management, category management, or trade and sales analytics — or equivalent experience in an adjacent commercial role.

**Preferred**

jobs.title: Product Operations and Support Specialist
jobs.description:
### **About Aegis Ventures**


**Aegis Ventures** is a next\-generation startup studio that partners with entrepreneurs and industry leaders to originate, launch, and scale transformative companies, with a focus on artificial intelligence. The Aegis platform brings together market\-shaping ideas, permanent growth capital, and ambitious individuals who are driven to solve major societal problems. Our companies use technology to transform healthcare by dramatically improving quality, access, and cost. Aegis creates new companies with substantial input from our Digital Consortium of a dozen leading health systems and other ecosystem partners. We have launched 6 innovative companies to date and are just getting started.


### **About the Company**


**Optain** is a revolutionary healthcare company that uses groundbreaking software and hardware technology to rethink care. We use the eye as a window to the body to improve the way we detect and manage eye and systemic conditions. Optain is committed to expanding and improving care through the introduction of AI and machine learning technology in frontline care settings at an accessible price. This not only promotes greater access to care, but promises to reduce the strains of overburdened healthcare systems.



Originally founded in Australia in 2019, Optain seeks to commercialize the inventions of Professor Mingguang He, a preeminent clinician\-scientist and scholar in the field of ophthalmology. Optain has achieved regulatory approval and commercial adoption of its product suite in global markets, including Australia, Europe, and more.



In 2025, Optain received US FDA clearance for its Resolve retinal camera. Optain also recently closed a Series A funding round led by Insight Partners with participation from seven leading U.S. health system investors, including Memorial Hermann Health System, Northwell Health, Novant Health, The Ohio State University Wexner Medical Center, and UPMC. These systems collectively deliver care to 28 million patients across 25 states and have begun deploying Optain's platform across their networks, rapidly accelerating the company's footprint and expanding screening access nationwide.


### **About the Job**



As the **Product Operations and Support Specialist**, you will be the escalation point for customers using Optain’s robotic retinal camera and supporting software. Because our product is a tightly integrated hardware\-software medical device deployed in live clinical settings, you will troubleshoot issues that span device hardware, image capture software, image quality, connectivity, EHR integrations, and downstream teleophthalmology grading workflows. In the U.S., Optain pairs its FDA\-cleared Resolve camera with rapid teleophthalmology grading; in international markets, Optain offers AI\-enabled Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) for screening common eye diseases and cardiovascular risk.



This is a high\-ownership, U.S.\-based remote role on a growing product team, reporting to the VP of Product. Beyond hands\-on Tier 2 support, issue investigation, and medical device complaint handling, you will enable our Customer Support team, feed real\-world signal back to the Product team, and own the internal operations, tooling, and projects that make the Product and Support teams more effective.


### **What You'll Do**


* Serve as Tier 2 support for customers who escalate device feedback, complaints, and semi\-technical product issues; reproducing, diagnosing, and resolving problems across the hardware\-software boundary, distinguishing camera or hardware faults from software, image\-quality, connectivity, EHR\-integration, or user technique issues.
* Capture, document, and route device feedback and complaints in line with Optain’s quality management system and applicable regulations (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR), recognizing when feedback may constitute a reportable complaint or potential adverse event and escalating appropriately to Quality and Regulatory.
* Support the Customer Success team with semi\-technical product and onboarding questions, acting as the bridge between front\-line CS and Engineering support. Contribute to knowledge base articles, troubleshooting guides, and training resources that enable CS to resolve more issues independently.
* Own internal operations and projects for the product team, including specifying requirements for internal support tooling, improving support and complaint\-handling workflows, and coordinating cross\-functional projects from intake to delivery.
* Support Quality in tracking and analyzing support and complaint trends, translate recurring problems into prioritized product improvement recommendations, and serve as a voice of the customer within the product organization.
* Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Quality, Regulatory, and Customer Success to ensure issues are resolved quickly while meeting the documentation rigor required of a regulated medical device.

### **What You'll Need**


* 3\+ years in technical support, product support, application support, or product operations for software as a medical device (SaMD), or combined hardware software medical device product.
* Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot across hardware\-software boundaries, isolating whether a problem originates in a hardware device, software, image quality, connectivity, or user technique. Ability to reproduce issues occurring on equipment at a remote customer site.
* Familiarity working within a quality management system and complaint\-handling processes in a regulated environment (e.g., FDA 21 CFR 820 / QMSR, ISO 13485, or EU MDR), including an understanding of when an issue may be a reportable complaint or adverse event.
* Strong written communication, with a track record of building knowledge base articles, runbooks, or training that enables less\-technical teammates to resolve issues independently. Demonstrated ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technic

jobs.description:
Mind Computing is seeking a fulltime, 100% remote **Product Owner / Business Analyst** to support a project with the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA). The ideal candidate will serve as the bridge between business stakeholders and Agile delivery teams, translating business objectives and federal requirements into actionable product direction. This role will focus on product backlog management, user story development, stakeholder collaboration, and Agile delivery, with an emphasis on federal healthcare workflows, EDI transactions, interoperability standards, and SAFe/Agile methodologies while ensuring solutions meet security, accessibility, and compliance requirements.


The candidate must reside within the continental US.


**Responsibilities:**

  

* Establish and maintain a product vision and roadmap aligned with agency mission, strategic objectives, and federal requirements.
* Translate federal healthcare priorities, policies, and modernization initiatives into actionable product and backlog items (e.g., MISSION Act, VA Modernization, Interoperability Rules).
* Ensure product direction aligns with enterprise architecture, data governance, and interoperability standards.
* Own, manage, and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, compliance requirements, stakeholder priorities, and urgency.
* Develop detailed user stories and acceptance criteria reflecting complex federal healthcare workflows, including referrals, scheduling, RFS, and EDI transactions.
* Ensure backlog items meet Definition of Ready and Definition of Done requirements, including security and accessibility considerations.
* Serve as the primary liaison between business owners, SMEs, clinical stakeholders, and technical delivery teams.
* Manage stakeholder expectations and facilitate communication across business and technical teams.
* Ensure product features and releases comply with HIPAA, Section 508 accessibility requirements, and agency specific security controls.
* Coordinate with teams supporting related products and systems across the enterprise portfolio.
* Ensure product capabilities support healthcare interoperability standards and workflows, including HL7, FHIR, and EDI 278/275/217 transactions.
* Lead and participate in backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and release planning.
* Review completed functionality against acceptance criteria and business requirements prior to release.
* Coordinate with development, testing, security, and change management teams to ensure releases are fully tested, documented, and approved.
* Identify opportunities to improve access to services, reduce administrative burden, and enhance overall service delivery.
* Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

**Qualifications:**

  

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business, or a related discipline.
* Minimum of 8 years of professional analyst experience.
* Demonstrated experience working as a Product Owner and/or Business Analyst within Agile delivery environments.
* Strong experience with SAFe/Agile methodologies, including backlog management, user story development, refinement, sprint planning, and release planning.
* Demonstrated expertise with EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) transactions, including hands on experience analyzing, interpreting, and validating EDI data within complex enterprise workflows.
* Strong understanding of software development and product delivery processes, including requirements gathering, analysis, documentation, and validation.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex business challenges and develop effective solutions.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and coordinate across multiple stakeholders and delivery teams.

**Additional Qualifications:**


* Experience with SAFe/Agile.
* SAFe Product Owner/Product Manager (POPM) certification preferred.
* Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) or other federal/government agencies.
* Familiarity with HL7, FHIR, EDI 278/275/217, and healthcare integration workflows.
* Experience working with HIPAA, Section 508, federal security controls, and government compliance requirements.
* Ability to obtain government clearance.

**Benefits:**


* Medical/Dental/Vision
* PTO \+ Federal Holidays
* Corporate Laptop
* Training opportunities
* 401(k) with employer match
* Remote work options


**Note: Selected candidates will be required to complete fingerprinting at a government facility and undergo a background check as part of the hiring process.**


Mind Computing is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability, or protected veteran status.

Note: By applying to this position you will have an opportunity to share your preferred working location from the following: **Austin, TX, USA; San Francisco, CA, USA; Sunnyvale, CA, USA**.### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8 years of experience in a customer\-facing role working with stakeholders, managing customer technical implementations or transformation programs.
* Experience supporting customers in cloud operations (e.g., launch or capacity planning, product release management), cloud technical support, cloud escalation management, or cloud consulting.

  

### **Preferred qualifications:**

* MBA or Master’s degree in a Management, Technical, or Engineering field.
* Experience translating business requirements into technological solutions.
* Experience in application or workload migration to public cloud providers.
* Experience collaborating with teams, groups, business units, channel partners, systems integrators, and third\-party developers to deliver solutions.
* Understanding of IT operations, database systems, networking, IT security, application development, service architecture, cloud\-native application development, hosted services, storage systems, or content delivery networks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, problem\-solving, and client management skills.

**About the job**
-----------------


As a Senior Technical Account Manager (TAM), you will help organizations successfully onboard Google Cloud products. You will guide them through the technical facets of their transformation journey and manage the delivery of Consulting engagements. In this role, you will regularly collaborate with various groups, including enterprise leadership and a geographically dispersed team.Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise\-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting\-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.Individual pay is determined by factors including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  

  

US: $140000 \- $204000 (USD) \+ 15% bonus target \+ equity \+ benefits  

  

Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Accelerate customer adoption of Google Cloud by leading the implementation journey. Provide technical guidance and manage timelines, milestones, migration goals, and business transformation strategies.
* Advocate for customer needs in order to overcome adoption blockers and drive new feature development. Lead across multiple workstreams and teams to maintain customer momentum.
* Develop relationships with stakeholders to understand the customer’s business, develop roadmaps, and lead quarterly business reviews and executive sessions to better understand business and technical needs.
* Plan for customer events and launches, partnering with Support, Engineers, and Site Reliability Engineers to ensure customer success, and work with customers and Support to guide issues/escalations to resolution.
* Develop best practices and assets based on learnings from customer engagements to support initiatives to scale through partners and accelerate Google Cloud adoption.

new_jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
PayRange LLC is searching for a Sales Manager to join our Laundry Sales team! We are seeking a high\-performing Sales Manager to help lead our business development efforts in the commercial laundry sector. As a fully vertically integrated technology provider, we offer a seamless ecosystem of digital payment devices supported by our cloud\-based management platform. This position will be responsible for executing a consultative sales process, moving beyond simple transactions to become a trusted advisor for commercial laundry professionals.

  


**Job Details:**



This is a heavily client facing role that will focus on the sale of PayRange products and services in a designated geographical territory and market segment. This position can be remote, provided that the location is inside the designated area, and close to a major transportation hub. The US office for PayRange LLC is in Portland, OR, however, you will only occasionally be at this location, outside of your first few weeks of training. The bulk of your client base in this role will focus on Laundry Route Operators, Commercial Laundry Equipment Distributors.

  



The expected territory for this Sales Manager position covers the Western United States. Once fully trained the expectations of this role will require you to travel 40%\+ of the year, as you will be tasked with holding in\-person meetings to close deals. The ideal candidate will be comfortable developing new business, maintaining existing relationships, and be able to increase revenue with existing clients

  



Strong candidates for this Sales Manager role will need to have the following skills:


Consultative Sales Execution: Lead the end\-to\-end sales cycle using a value\-based approach, identifying specific pain points in client operations, and tailoring our integrated payment solutions platform to meet their unique needs.  

* 
* SaaS Familiarization: Have general knowledge of SaaS monetization principles. For example, selling subscription\-based systems and an understanding of SaaS monetization methods (e.g., transaction fees, monthly recurring revenue).
* Business Development: Demonstrate the ability to develop new business organically, and from referred sales leads. Also, this role will be expected to develop and manage on\-going customer relationships and work with all levels of stakeholders within the client’s organization by building rapport and becoming a “trusted advisor”
* Assist your current accounts with renewals and contract extensions
* Have prior experience in long sales cycles
* Diligent tracking of your sales forecast and ability to provide detailed reporting to PayRange LLC leadership by means of a CRM software tool
* Stay abreast of trends in the commercial laundry and fintech industries to position our vertically integrated model against traditional coin\-operated or fragmented competitors.

  


**Qualifications:**


* 3\+ years of experience with equipment sales and/or enterprise level software sales demonstrating the ability to achieve sales goals and drive revenue using proven sales methods
* Prior experience in commercial laundry sales is preferred.
* Ability to develop and manage senior\-role relationships and work with multiple client\-based stakeholders
* Expert networking ability and business development with both PayRange LLC staff, as well as, with the clients in the assigned market
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and closing skills
* Excellent presentation and writing skills
* Effective time management and organizational abilities
* Ability to collaborate with other Sales staff across the PayRange LLC team to assist in selling a complete suite of platform, software, services, and hardware
* Ability to travel within the designated territory (and occasionally greater North America) at a minimum of 40%\+ of the time.
* College or University degree is preferred

new_jobs.title: Seasonal Operations Associate (BOH)
new_jobs.description:
**WHO WE ARE:**


Neiman Marcus is a leading luxury retailer that provides a curated product assortment, unparalleled services, and exclusive activations for customers in *Pursuit of the Extraordinary*. It is known for creating the Neiman Marcus magic through exceptional customer experiences including the Neiman Marcus Awards, Fantasy Gifts, seasonal campaigns, and “Retail\-tainment” initiatives. Neiman Marcus has a rich history as a brand builder, bringing together the world's top luxury designers and customers to foster a dedicated following for generations. It serves customers across its 36 stores, digital channels, and through remote selling. It is part of Saks Global’s portfolio of world\-class luxury retailers and real estate assets.

**YOU WILL BE:**


As a Seasonal Operations Associate, you will work to enhance our client experience with our operations team during our most magical time of year. Reporting to an Operations Manager, the team Makes Life Extraordinary by leading with a people first mentality and ensuring exceptional execution of assignments.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO:**

* Unload and sort inbound merchandise and prepare the merchandise for the selling floor
* Prepare outbound merchandise to be shipped to a client, another store or the distribution center
* Complete daily inventory control operations
* Execute merchandise price changes as needed
* Ensure all safety procedures are followed on the receiving dock and in all other work areas

**WHAT YOU WILL BRING:**

* Minimum 1 year of experience in an operations or warehouse role(s)
* Familiar with and able to use retail and mobile technologies
* Requires standing, bending, climbing stairs, and lifting and carrying up to 35 pounds
* Must be willing to work a flexible schedule based on business needs which will include nights, weekends and holidays

**YOUR LIFE AND CAREER AT NEIMAN MARCUS:**

* Opportunity to work in a dynamic fast paced environment at a company experiencing growth and transformation
* Exposure to rewarding career advancement opportunities across the largest multi\-brand luxury retailer from retail to distribution, to digital or corporate
* Comprehensive benefits package for all eligible full\-time employees (including medical, vision and dental)
* An amazing employee discount

**SALARY AND OTHER BENEFITS:**


The starting salary for this position is between $20\.00 \- $22\.00 hourly. Factors which may affect starting pay within this range may include market, experience and other qualifications of the successful candidate.


Thank you for your interest with Saks Global. We look forward to reviewing your application.


Saks Global is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Saks Global and would like to request special assistance or an accommodation, please contact the store.

 **Exemplar Luxury Group is an equal employment opportunity employer and is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. If you are interested in applying for employment with Exemplar Luxury Group and would like to request special assistance or an accommodation, please contact** **candidatesupport@exemplarluxury.com****.**

  

Compensation for this role varies by geographic location. The listed range reflects multiple markets, including higher\-cost areas. Actual starting pay will be determined based on work location, experience, and other job\-related factors.

new_jobs.description:
**About the Role:**

Ready to put your audit\-savvy superpowers to work? We’re looking for a Project Manager who thrives on untangling complex regulations, partnering with auditors, and turning risk assessments into clear, actionable insights. In this role, you’ll shape audit plans, guide internal and external reviews, and help keep our organization aligned with key standards from SOC to HIPAA and beyond. If you enjoy connecting the dots between process, compliance, and business impact, you’ll fit right in. Join us and bring clarity, confidence, and a little bit of fun to the world of audits!


**What****You’ll****Do:**

* Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of internal and external audits to ensure operational integrity and regulatory readiness.
* Collaborate with auditors and stakeholders to ensure operational integrity, regulatory readiness, and clear communication of audit outcomes.
* Maintain and manage compliance documentation aligned with SOC, HIPAA, PCI DSS, BSA/AML, and international data privacy laws.
* Develop audit plans and define key areas for evaluation.

**Who You Are:**

* Bachelor's degree in information technology, business administration, legal studies, or similar
* Four plus (4\+) years of compliance, audit, or risk management experience
* Two (2\) years of project management experience, preferably in a technology (SAAS) environment
* Experience writing policies and procedures, preferably compliance related
* Clear and concise verbal and written communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy
* Excellent organizational skills
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Outlook, Word, Excel, Teams, and SharePoint
* Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively
* Willingness and ability to learn and develop new areas of expertise
* Process driven and with sound judgment
* Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build rapport and maintain professional relationships
* Flexibility and the ability to manage changing priorities

**Ideal to Have:**

* Knowledge and skills in compliance and audit processes, with a focus on information security, financial services, accessibility, and privacy
* Familiarity with compliance frameworks such as SOX, HIPAA, PCI DSS, BSA/AML and international data privacy regulations
